translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

book.name: 2 KORINTI
book.title: Paurongo Korinti Kpebung Yeneac Ngadekibi Ohoec

content: Negen negennango yofi negensidua, ni monggoc ubaebic meficgengemmebaiac wama mi habade.
Neng hanahema ubaebic meficgengemmebadeu ngenearunac mongngo ubangerec naric mi meficgenenude.

Nga ngenearu haba goa ngeneng ubangerec meficgenengandae, imocac negemba ngereede. Ngeni ubaebic meficgenembauac kibi mong ohongemmeai. Ni ngeneac yofi negengyombonggeduae, sogac sogai nearu fedeu ngeni sasawango sogaigecde.
Ni heresongotoagoc hoangngunuduae, imoc negenggecdeac kibi ohoai. Amma herenango dehou anenu ubaebic kuneng mema kiacma kibingina ohongemmeaimoc, imocngo ebic ngemmebadeac mi ohoai, kpac.
Ngic ubaebic meficgenemmeec, ye ubaebic nisac mi meficgenenec, kpac. Yeng ine ngeni sasawa ubaebic meficgengemmeec. Imocac homac mi debade, imocsac deduae.
Nga ngeni homacngo ngic imoc kopocsihaac amma demeting bic ammigec, imocngo yofinenggac soha anu ifi monggoc mi ammibisia.
Yeng ubamangang ebirangoc kecma kpac ambacac ngeni ine kopocsiha wama demeseri ammima
heresongongina edzahebisia, imoc seria dema edengunuduae.
Ngeni sasawango yoacna tofohogecde me kpac, imoc negentegecbadeac kibina ohongemmeai.
Nga ngeni ngic monggac kopocsic wagecdeu neng ifingoc yeac kopocsic wabade. Nga kopocsic mong wabadeu imoc Kristoac kpacfu ngeneac amma waduae.
Satanggac faitobannu manunubacac ifi ambisia. Yeng faitobang arenggeande, imocac sirihaac mi obohodimbe.
Anu Troa taonnu hama Kristoac siduc gombung edekpou ayemmebadeac Kebungo singa bic mesarinenec.
Hama Tito hoforaiac ongaasunango ruae mi meficgeu ine dekenec amma faiyunuma Makedonia bangecfu kenai.
Anu Kristogoc kpeketahema kecni Anutungo nasosoc yeac firanggac arennu hesicnunuude. Hesicnunuu guruamasoc kenni Yesuac siducngo homung kerengagoc amma imocngo uaninau fingecma kengkefude.

Kristogoc kpeketahema kecni sebihomunnina gombunga Anutuaru enude. Ngicngac komoc kpegecde, yeneac botucfu imocngo homuna gombunga kekehagoc amma kekec yemmeude. Nga hofeac sing modacandae, imoc yeneac botucfu ine hoachomung kpedzini imocngo homec yemmeude. Tembucnina ua imoc naric mi mebing, kpac. Kristogoc kpeketahema kecni ifi fingerude.

Ngic goa yeni hiedzotoa kirecgeyemmeudeac negemma Anutuac yoac deandae. Yeni isoc mi angkecdimbe, kpac. Anutungo suenunuu yeac negensima Kristogoc kpeketahema kecni ubaherenina dindingac femanu Anutuac yoac dekperagiandimbe.
